value.signature: fn vendors (root : & Path) -> Result < Vec < PathBuf > >

review.body: { let manifest_path = root . join ("ci/vendor-packages.toml") ; let manifest : toml :: Value = toml :: from_str (& read (& manifest_path) ?) . map_err (| error | format ! ("{}: {error}" , manifest_path . display ())) ? ; let packages = manifest . get ("packages") . and_then (toml :: Value :: as_array) . ok_or ("ci/vendor-packages.toml: packages must be an explicit list") ? ; let mut vendors = Vec :: new () ; for package in packages { let name = package . get ("path") . and_then (toml :: Value :: as_str) . ok_or ("ci/vendor-packages.toml: package path must be a string") ? ; if ! name . starts_with ("vendor/") || name . split ('/') . any (| part | part . is_empty () || part == "." || part == "..") || name . contains (['*' , '?' , '[' , '\\']) { return Err (format ! ("ci/vendor-packages.toml: package path must be explicit and normalized: {name}") . into ()) ; } vendors . push (PathBuf :: from (name)) ; } Ok (vendors) }
review.item_premise: Only the committed public vendor package declaration and normalized public paths are consumed. The census admits declared roots independent of workspace membership and refuses malformed paths; it introduces no secret carrier or exposure boundary.
